newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Arabian share trading, value drop in week.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian share trading, value drop in week.

text.p: Trade slowed on the Saudi stock market last week, official figures released on Sunday showed.
The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA), the kingdom's central bank, said volume fell to 2.74 million shares in the week to Thursday from three million shares a week earlier.
The value of shares traded declined to 476.6 million riyals ($127 million) from 654.5 million riyals the week before.
SAMA, quoted by the official Saudi Press Agency, said 58 firms were traded last week. Share prices of 27 rose, 22 dropped and nine were unchanged.
The agency said cement shares dominated trading with 1.26 million shares worth 206.7 million riyals changing hands.
